stats.label: Hit rate
stats.method: P(B > 0) + Σ_k P(B = 0, K = k)·(1 − P(F = 0 | k)) over the base distribution, P(F = 0) from the feature DP

stats.label: Win > stake rate
stats.method: P(X > stake): exact part 9.1509e-2 (base spin already > the stake) + Monte Carlo of the 3.219e-3 mass of triggered rounds that still depend on the feature: 200,000 rounds sampled from the mc base and mc feature distributions (features simulated spin by spin), weighted by that exact mass

stats.label: Volatility (SD per round, stakes)
stats.method: UNCAPPED: √(E[X²] − E[X]²), E[X²] = E[B²] + 2Σ_k E[B·1{K=k}]·E[F|k] + Σ_k P(K=k)·E[F²|k] (B ⟂ F given K), exact moments from the feature DP; the cap only lowers it

stats.label: Feature frequency
stats.method: 1 / P(K ≥ 4), P from the sampled base distribution

stats.label: Average feature win
stats.method: E[F | trigger] / bet, uncapped (exact free-spins algebra)

stats.label: P(win ≥ 100×) per round
stats.method: P(X ≥ 100·stake): exact part 5.4888e-5 (base spin already ≥ 100×) + Monte Carlo of the 3.845e-3 mass of triggered rounds that still depend on the feature: 200,000 rounds sampled from the mc base and mc feature distributions (features simulated spin by spin), weighted by that exact mass

stats.label: Max win (declared cap)
stats.method: slot.config.json maxWinStakes; a round that reaches it ends and pays it

stats.label: P(reaching the max win) per round
stats.method: exact bounds: P(B ≥ cap) + Σ over triggered entries with B < cap of P(F ≥ cap − B), bounded below and above by the free-spins DP (retriggers and multipliers included) with each spin's m·W rounded down / up to a 30-stake grid (500 bins up to the cap); P(B ≥ cap) exact + Monte Carlo of the triggered rounds with B < cap (15 of 200,000 reached the cap)

stats.label: Dry streak p95 (longest miss run in 100)
stats.method: exact DP over the current miss run, rounds iid with P(miss) = 1 − hit rate = 0.627823; p95 = smallest L with P(longest ≤ L) ≥ 0.95; at hit rate ± 3 SE it is 13–13

stats.label: Session (median balance after 200 rounds from 100)
stats.method: 20,000 sessions of 200 rounds at 1 stake from 100 stakes, rounds sampled from the mc base and mc feature distributions, capped per round; a player whose balance is below 1 stake stops (bust); median with a distribution-free order-statistic 95% CI
